description: Defines classes and methods for managing uplink context and repository in a wireless communication system, including resource grid handling, context management, and concurrency control.

classes.name: uplink_context
classes.description: Represents the uplink resource grid context, manages writing and retrieving resource data, and tracks written REs.

classes.name: uplink_context_resource_grid_info
classes.description: Holds information about the resource grid context and shared resource grid.

classes.name: uplink_context_repository
classes.description: Manages storage, concurrency, and lifecycle of multiple uplink contexts across slots and symbols.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the uplink_context instance.

methods.name: write_grid
methods.description: Writes IQ buffer data into the resource grid at specified port and RE start.

methods.name: try_getting_complete_resource_grid
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a complete resource grid if all REs are written.

methods.name: pop_uplink_context_resource_grid_info
methods.description: Retrieves and clears the stored resource grid info.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Enqueues a new uplink context into the repository for a specific slot and symbol range.

methods.name: write_grid
methods.description: Writes IQ data into the resource grid at a specific slot, port, symbol, and RE start.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a copy of the uplink context for a specific slot and symbol.

methods.name: try_popping_complete_resource_grid_symbol
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a complete resource grid for a slot and symbol, clearing it if successful.

methods.name: pop_resource_grid_symbol
methods.description: Pops and clears the resource grid info for a slot and symbol.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears a specific slot and symbol entry.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the entire repository, releasing shared resource grids.
